title: DEUS spell-effect data (SIM.60.02, schemaVersion deus-spell-effect/1.0.0)
description: Validates docs/schemas/spells/effects.json. One record per SRD spell that the SIM.60.01 audit marks physical, or NONE with an entity or meta primitive. A spell is data: a list of reusable primitive instances (DEC-018, R11: no per-spell code). SRD damage, range, saves, area, duration and casting are never copied here; they are pointers (srdRef) into srd_baseline.json (R1). DEUS numbers are pointers (tuningRef) into tuning.json. $defs/tuningFile and $defs/primitiveCatalogue validate tuning.json and primitives.json. The cross-file rules (SRD numbers, quotes, ledger names, ore, coverage, Q2) are in tools/spells/validate_spell_effects.js.

primitive.description: The 28 primitives of the SIM.60.01 audit (section 3.2; meta.primitiveSystems). primitives.json maps each to an ADR-003 Rev 3 section 18.6 core system or lists it as a gap.

srdRef.description: Pointer into srd_baseline.json: <spell slug>.<field>[<index>] (for example fireball.damage[0], wall-of-stone.measures[0], earthquake.duration) or <rule key>.<field>[<index>] for the SRD rule entries the baseline quotes (condition:petrified.measures[0]). A pointer into measures names the measure's unit, which the validator compares.

tuningRef.description: Name of a parameter in tuning.json. DEUS coefficients are per damage type or per effect kind, never per spell.

srdTerm.description: A qualitative SRD term quoted exactly (for example "strong wind"). The quote must be a substring of the spell's SRD text.

ownerOpenValue.description: A value the SRD does not settle and that an open Owner question decides (Q1-Q4). Stored with no value chosen.

variants.description: Caster-chosen modes the SRD names (for example create water or destroy water). An effect selects one with 'variant'.

ownerOpen.description: Consequences that would exist only under an Owner answer not yet given. Never effect data (Q3, Q4).

effect.description: One primitive instance. additionalProperties false: a per-spell script hook or any other extra property is rejected (R11).

trigger.description: onCast: at casting. onImpact: where the effect lands or explodes. perRound: at the start of each of the caster's turns (SRD rounds, never ticks). continuous: holds for the lifetime. onEnter: when a creature or object enters. onEnd: when the spell ends. onTrigger: a glyph or contingency trigger. onDestroyed: when the conjured thing is destroyed. onHit: on a hit with the spell or weapon. onCommand: on the caster's later action or bonus action.

basis.description: srd: the SRD text states this physical effect; srdQuote is an exact substring of the spell's SRD text. deus: a DEUS physical consequence added on top of the SRD (DEC-018) under a design rule of audit section 3.1; deusReason says why.

deusRule.description: The audit design rule (section 3.1) that adds this consequence, or DEC-018 for a consequence the ruling names directly (fire ignites combustibles and spreads; blasts damage structures; water floods and flows; cold freezes liquid; earth spells reshape strata).

magical.description: R10. true: a live magical effect owned by the spell instance (suppressed by magicSuppress, ended by magicEnd, ends with the spell). false: a mundane consequence that persists as ordinary world state (a fire already lit, water created, ice formed by cold).

schedule.description: SRD round numbers of a spell whose effects change by round (Storm of Vengeance): pointers into the spell's measures.

footprint.description: Where the effect applies, in SRD feet (DEC-013: 5-ft cells, 10-ft layers, 2-ft slices; no layer count is fixed here). 'area' reuses an SRD area entry. Without an SRD area entry, 'shape' names the target and 'dims' points at SRD measures.

lifetime.description: SRD duration by pointer: <spell>.duration (seconds from the quoted SRD round rule, 1 round = 6 s) or a time measure. timeDomain tags the clock (action or historical). Ticks are the runtime's business: ticks = ceil(seconds / secondsPerTick[timeDomain]), and secondsPerTick is Owner question Q2 (null in tuning.json).

energy.description: World energy from an SRD damage entry: the same roll the rules layer makes for creatures (one roll per cast, seeded), times a per-damage-type coefficient from tuning.json. The damage type is read from the pointed-at entry.

ledger.description: Conservation-ledger entry (LIFE-001, ADR-003 Rev 3 7.8, game/js/sim/ledger.js). none: no matter changes (downstream names the rows other systems use later). transform: moves between ledger (class, form) pairs, each naming a row of ledger_defaults.js or a listed gap. relocate: matter moves between cells, class and form unchanged. source / sink: conjured matter; the source or sink name comes from the Q1 policy row named by q1Case (tuning.json), never from the effect. policy: the direction and amount are decided by the Q1 policy row (bodies, planar storage).

p_ignite.description: Hands flammable targets to the fire system (SIM.50.05). Without 'threshold' every flammable target in the footprint ignites (the SRD wording); with it, only those that receive at least the threshold.

p_heatFlux.description: Adds or removes heat in cells, objects and fluids. Needs a stored temperature field (gap G-TEMP). The amount is the energy block, or a tuning magnitude when the SRD gives no damage.

p_volumeDamage.description: One core volume-damage system (ADR-003 18.2; SIM.40.01 section 8). The damage type comes from energy.damage; tuning.json maps it to a physical class. Attenuation is the material table (SIM.40.01 8.3).

invulnerable.description: SRD: immune to all damage (a flag; it names no SRD number).

p_conjureMatter.description: Creates solid matter that must meet a support rule and may fall (SIM.40.01-.02). The ledger class and form follow tuning.json tables.materialClass.

p_lightEmit.description: Bright and dim light (SRD radii by pointer). Needs a simulation light field (gap G-LIGHT); drawing it is presentation (WG.00.18).
